import json
demo_in=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo_in[r][c]=1
demo_out=[row[:] for row in demo_in]
for r in [7,9,11,13]: demo_out[r][r]=2
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r in [0,3,6]: test[r][r]=1
def f(g):
    n=len(g)
    ones=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if not ones: return out
    # check diagonal continuation
    diffs=[ones[i+1][0]-ones[i][0] for i in range(len(ones)-1)]
    step=diffs[-1] if diffs else 2
    if any(d!=step for d in diffs): return None
    r,c=ones[-1]
    while True:
        r+=step; c+=step
        if r>=n or c>=n: break
        out[r][c]=2
    return out
print(f(demo_in)==demo_out)
out=f(test)
for row in out: print(''.join(map(str,row)))
json.dump({"input":demo_in,"output":demo_out}, open('/tmp/demo1.json','w'))
